_comment: Simulated package registry data -- NOT a real third-party service. Built by hand for Week 9's exercise, thematically consistent with the docs domain (packages related to the GitHub/Swagger tooling this project already covers).

2.4.0.deprecation_note: octokit 2.x is unsupported; upgrade to 3.x, which uses the 2025-06-01 GitHub API version by default.

2.4.46.deprecation_note: swagger-codegen-cli 2.x only supports OpenAPI 2.0 specs and predates the v3 line; use 3.0.71 for OpenAPI 3.0.x support.

0.9.0.deprecation_note: 0.9.x had a known bug misreporting deprecated fields; upgrade to 1.2.0.
